scripts.build: bun run build:openlia-browser && bun run build:ui
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write packages/openlia-browser packages/workspace-ui package.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: bunx @biomejs/biome format packages/openlia-browser packages/workspace-ui package.json biome.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:openlia-browser && bun run typecheck:ui
scripts.test: bun run test:openlia-browser && bun run test:ui:server && bun run test:ui:client
scripts.verify-dist: bun run build && test -s packages/openlia-browser/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/server.js && test -s packages/workspace-ui/dist/client/index.html
scripts.docs:check: bun run docs:format:check && bun run docs:lint
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
